endorsements.name: Andrew Lemon
endorsements.label: How to rob a bank.
endorsements.description: We’ve all thought about it… every time you see a new toy you know you’ll never be able to afford, or when you know aren’t going to make ends meet this month. How would you do it? I suggest avoiding the jail time and learning from someone who’s successfully (legally) done it 20 times last year alone. Sometimes hitting multiple banks in the same day. Somewhere between a smash and grab and Oceans 11 is where we’ll land for this presentation. Everything from OSINT, PreTexting, and social engineering to physically planting dropboxes to pivot through the network exploiting cameras for shoulder surfing passwords and finally pivoting to monetizing all that hard work to a simple swift transfer or a full blown crypto vault heist.
endorsements.subtitle: GrrCON 2022
